description:
We’d love it if you had:

  • Attention to Details;
  • Ability to learn new software technologies;
  • Problem-solving skills
  • A technical, logical thought process 
  • Ability to work flexible shifts and to adapt to changing work schedules
  • Identifying Process Improvements;
  • Prioritizing Requests;
  • Nice to have: MCSA Windows Server, CCNA.

You need to successfully:

  • Identify, troubleshoot, and fix users IT issues;
  • Create and update knowledge base;
  • Help users for using in efficient way IT systems and tools provided by the company;
  • Answer and treat each issue according with procedures via ticketing system
  • Installing and configuring company workstations, software, network systems, printers, and scanners;
  • Monitoring and maintaining computer systems and networks.
  • Software and application management (install, configure and removal;
  • AD accounts management (change passwords or create new accounts).
  • Asset management (add new assets, change assets status);
  • Troubleshoot applications when incidents arise and escalate them to the responsible authority
  • Cooperate with other teams;
  • Communicate with service providers if the need arises

Nice to have:

  • Knowledge in PowerShell Scripting, WMI, GPOs, IIS, AV Solutions and Admin Center;
  • Understanding of SCCM, VPN, Proxy, RADIUS, Networks, Subnets and VLANs.

What comes with the job?

  • A motivating salary package & flexible benefits.
  • Specialized trainings & free access to learning platforms.
  • Subscription to medical services.
  • Opportunities for development and promotion within a young and dynamic team.
  • Pleasant working environment in a continuously expanding company.
